risk_note: RV2 ledger (settlement-plan B2-04k; BR-FUND-19, 22, 10, BR-WDR-05; S4, S21). registerReconDiff(trx, …) registers a recon diff idempotently on the business key, the partial-unique dedupe_key and the month-end key (a repeat returns the existing row and never overwrites status or resolution; a concurrent repeat waits for the winner); getReconDiffs is a read-only query by app, status and order key. ledger.post compares each user account's available balance before and after in the same transaction and publishes account.went_negative through the platform event bus only when it crosses from >=0 to <0 (already negative or turning positive: no event; failure rolls back the whole voucher). EVENT_BUS is injected optionally, as elsewhere in the repo, so entries without a database still boot. Only apps/api/src/modules/ledger/** changed; no schema change.
